title: Model serving and inference
summary: Models as reliable inference services: serving architecture, SageMaker, open-weight LLM engines (vLLM, SGLang), TensorRT-LLM and edge, and GPUs inside a customer's own environment.
intro: This module covers how trained models become reliable inference services: the architecture of online and batch serving, the managed route through SageMaker, and the specialised runtimes used for large language models. It moves from general serving patterns to LLM engines and then to compilation, quantization and edge targets, where latency and cost are won. It ends with GPU infrastructure and model serving for inference workloads in infrastructure the customer owns.

lessons.title: Model serving architecture: inference APIs for batch and real-time demand
Managed deployment and serving with Amazon SageMaker AI
Serving open-weight LLMs with vLLM and SGLang
Low-latency inference: TensorRT-LLM, quantization and edge deployment
GPU infrastructure and model serving for inference workloads
